name: writing-cowork
description: Multi-role cowork pattern (PM, substance, voice/tone, review) for long-form writing projects. Skills install scaffolds, manage drift, run reviews, and coordinate role handoffs across a project's git-tracked vault. **v0.1.17 (v0.1.15 and v0.1.16 folded in, never released standalone):** information architecture spine — CLAUDE.md Tier-1 router with plugin-managed/project-owned ownership markers; visible git-tracked project memory (process/memory/); activity log (process/Log.md); file_ownership.md as the plugin-managed provenance registry; pm-close-session, pm-install-router, pm-init-memory, pm-init-log, pm-install-git-hooks, pm-migrate-todos-schema; drift_check v0.4.0 session-hygiene checks plus a config preflight (unreadable input and unrecognized config keys are reported, never silently clean); git post-commit enforcement (Claude Code hooks dropped — they do not run in Cowork). Also carries v0.1.15: plugin root moved to 0_Product/ and drift_check.py bundled. (v0.1.17)
